requirements.title: The early-expiry switch in configuration
requirements.rationale: Early removal after landing can be turned off per hub; the switch is read once at start. The lifetime limits default_ttl and max_ttl and the rule that judges a ttl belong to package 15, which applies them at creation.

criteria.condition: parleyd loads a configuration with or without `[forks].expire_on_land`
criteria.action: use true when the key is omitted and the given boolean when it is present
criteria.contract: the loaded configuration reports expire_on_land true for an empty file and for a file that sets only the other `[forks]` keys, false for `expire_on_land = false` and true for `expire_on_land = true`

check.pseudocode: in internal/config/forks_test.go, beside the table of package 15's keys, a table over configuration texts {empty, only [forks] default_ttl="2d", [forks] expire_on_land=false, [forks] expire_on_land=true}: cfg = Load(text); assert cfg.Forks.ExpireOnLand equals the expected value of the row and the three keys of package 15 are as that package's table expects

requirements.title: Extending or shortening a fork's lifetime
requirements.rationale: An owner whose task runs longer than planned keeps the fork, and one who is done early can let it go sooner.

criteria.condition: the fork's creator, the owner of its parent or the admin token sends `PATCH /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}` with a valid `ttl` for a fork whose parent is `ready`
criteria.action: set the fork's `expires_at` to the time of the request plus the `ttl`, whether that is later or earlier than before, and set `updated_at`
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the workspace object whose `expires_at` equals the request time plus `ttl`; a later `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}` returns the same `expires_at`

criteria.condition: the `ttl` of an update of a fork is `null`, a number, a boolean, a string that is not a duration, shorter than 5 minutes or longer than `[forks].max_ttl`
criteria.action: refuse the whole update and change nothing
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with `error_type` `invalid_request`; `expires_at`, `updated_at` and every other field named in the same body are unchanged; no `parley.workspace.update` event is written

requirements.title: Deleting a fork on request
requirements.rationale: A finished task should not hold storage, credentials and a slug until its lifetime runs out; and a half-removed fork would leave a live credential for something that no longer exists.

criteria.condition: the fork's creator, the owner of its parent or the admin token sends `DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}` for a fork whose parent is `ready` or `archived`
criteria.action: remove the fork and its own branches without changing any branch of the parent
criteria.contract: HTTP 204 with an empty body; afterwards `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}` answers HTTP 404 with `error_type` `not_found`, the fork is absent from the parent's fork list, its own branches no longer resolve, every branch of the parent has the head it had before, and a fork created later under the same name has none of the removed fork's own branches

requirements.title: Removing forks with their parent
requirements.rationale: A fork cannot outlive the repository it shares history with, and the parent's delete must stay one step that happens entirely or not at all.

criteria.condition: the delete of a repository workspace (package 14) calls RemoveForksOf of the registered fork remover inside its store transaction
criteria.action: remove every fork of that workspace with cause `parent_deleted`, return the removed fork slugs in ascending order, and discard the forks' own branches only after the transaction has committed
criteria.contract: the step returns the slugs of all forks of the parent sorted ascending (an empty list for a parent without forks) and a function that discards their repository data; after the commit no fork of the parent has a record and every token bound to one of them answers HTTP 401

requirements.title: Expiry sweep
requirements.rationale: Forks must disappear without anyone deleting them, and the record must say that the hub, not a person, removed each one.

criteria.condition: a sweep pass runs
criteria.action: remove, with cause `expired`, every fork whose `expires_at` is at or before the current time, including forks of an archived parent, and leave every other fork in place
criteria.contract: after the pass `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}` answers HTTP 404 for each fork that was past `expires_at` and HTTP 200 for each fork that was not

execution_paths.title: An agent extends its fork and later deletes it from the shell

steps.action: runs `parley fork extend demo--t1 --ttl 2d` with a token bound to the fork
checks access and the parent's state, sets expires_at to now plus 2 days and writes parley.workspace.update
prints the fork with its new expires_at and exits 0
runs `parley fork delete demo--t1` when the task is done
removes the fork, its secrets and own branches through the removers of owned data, revokes the bound token and writes parley.workspace.delete in one transaction
prints the confirmation document and exits 0
reads the fork again with the same token and is answered 401

end_state: after the extend the fork's expires_at is two days after the command ran
after the delete GET /api/v1/workspaces/demo--t1 as U answers 404 and the bound token answers 401
